item.title: Omaha businesses closing Friday as part of nationwide general strike
item.description: Multiple Omaha businesses, including Sheelytown Market in Little Italy, are closing Friday to participate in a nationwide general strike protesting federal immigration enforcement actions.

item.title: Papillion-La Vista basketball player, cancer survivor receives nonprofit help for prosthetic
item.description: 🏀 When cancer forced Avery Krause to step away from basketball, she thought her dreams were over. Now a local nonprofit is helping her get closer to returning.

item.title: Student struck by vehicle outside Fremont High School during ICE protest walkout
item.description: A Fremont High School student was struck by a vehicle during a student-organized walkout protesting ICE enforcement, with witnesses recording the incident.
